Celestial Chocolate Pie
A Christmas Prayer
Oh God, Creator of All,
We offer this humble prayer on Christmas Day.
HELP us as we come together today
To have a song of Thanks in our hearts,
A song of Redemption, a song of Renewal.
GRANT that we may understand
The profound mystery of Christmas:
In Jesus we saw the Hope for Forgiveness
And Peace among men and women of goodwill,
Knowing that we are all children of Yours.
STRENGTHEN our hearts with Gratitude
For Your Infinite Goodness.
JOIN us all together with Joy in Your Love.
Amen
.
